title: Place homepage category and project actions as route cells
objective: Replace the rectangular homepage category and selected-work cards with real-link, cell-like route nodes placed directly on the mathematical connector.
non_goals: shared card component behavior on subpages
acceptance_checks: Automation, Datenanalyse, and all three selected-work items keep their current real link destinations
the five homepage actions have an organic cell-like form rather than a rectangular card form
each cell center follows the live mathematical route at its document position
the connector remains visible as an underlying path and content remains legible
keyboard focus remains visible without motion

result.summary: Automation, Datenanalyse, and the three selected-work actions now render as clickable organic route cells. Their x-position is taken from the live harmonic route at each cell's document height; all original destinations and real links remain intact.

reviews.orchestrator_semantics_accessibility_rev: pass: category cells remain anchors, project cells retain their real primary links and progressive whole-card enhancement, and focus does not move the cells.
reviews.orchestrator_visual_integration_review: pass: all five actions read as organic cells placed directly on the route, with legible content and restrained category identity markers.
